findings.description: When the start date falls on a weekend and n is a multiple of 5, the algorithm adds a full 7‑day week per 5 business days, overshooting by one week. This produces incorrect results for such cases.
findings.evidence: Example: start = date(2026, 11, 5) (Saturday), n = 5. Expected result is date(2026, 11, 10) (Friday). Candidate returns date(2026, 11, 14) (Monday), which is 4 days late, violating the contract.

review.summary: Candidate implementation incorrectly handles weekend starts when n is a multiple of 5, leading to wrong business day calculations.
